ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious IIS Module Registration
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious IIS module registration as described in Microsoft threat report on IIS backdoors

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\w3wp\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*appcmd\\\.exe\\ add\\ module.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ system\\\.enterpriseservices\\\.internal\\\.publish.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*gacutil.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/I.*")))
